answer: By tying each identity to staking collateral in a dynamic opportunity-cost bond, we expose the fable of costless identity multiplication. Our protocol deploys a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function as a computational ridge, coupled with subgame-perfect slashing penalties. This architecture reduces the expected utility of any Sybil attack below zero, sequestering malicious deposits in an unrecoverable liquidity lagoon. Thus, the system converges to a strict Nash equilibrium where honest node operations remain the uniquely dominant strategy.
